<!-- footer -->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
pkg_ver <- tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion("zbarc")), error = function(e) "dev")
pkg_desc <- tryCatch(utils::packageDescription("zbarc"), error = function(e) list())
repo_url <- if (!is.null(pkg_desc$URL) && !is.na(pkg_desc$URL)) {
  # Extract first http(s) URL if multiple entries exist in DESCRIPTION
  urls <- unlist(strsplit(pkg_desc$URL, "[,\\s]+"))
  gh <- urls[grepl("^https?://github\\.com/", urls)]
  if (length(gh) > 0) gh[1] else urls[1]
} else {
  "https://github.com/<owner>/zbarc"
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
htmltools::tags$footer(
  style = paste(
    "margin-top: 36px; padding: 14px 18px;",
    "border-top: 1px solid var(--tbl-border);",
    "font-size: 12px; color: var(--tbl-text); opacity: 0.85;",
    "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px;"
  ),
  htmltools::div(
    "Generated with ",
    htmltools::strong("zbarc"),
    sprintf(" (v%s)", pkg_ver)
  ),
  htmltools::div(
    htmltools::tags$a(
      href = repo_url,
      target = "_blank",
      rel = "noopener noreferrer",
      style = "color: var(--tbl-accent); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;",
      "GitHub Repository"
    )
  )
)
```
